name: Tooltip
summary: A short hint beside a control, shown while it's hovered or has keyboard focus: the name of an icon-only control, a truncated label in full, or a few words of description. Never holds anything to click, and never the only place information lives on touch screens. Not for help with links (use a Popover) or for errors (use the field's message). Icon-only Buttons and MenuButtons, and unavailable Buttons, carry this hint themselves (`useHint`): wrap one only for a shortcut or a side, and the wrapper's hint replaces the built-in one.
a11y: `role="tooltip"`. A `description` hint is linked from the control with `aria-describedby`; a `label` hint is hidden from assistive technology because the control's name says the same. It shows after a short wait on hover (`c.tooltip.delay`), at once on keyboard focus, and at once on the next control after one has shown. It stays while the pointer moves onto it (WCAG 1.4.13 hoverable), stays until the pointer or focus leaves, and Escape hides it without moving focus (dismissible). A press on the control hides it. It opens in the top layer, flips to the other side when there's no room, and shifts to stay in the window. Reduced motion: it appears without a fade.

props.name: content
props.description: The hint: a few words, never a sentence to act on, never links or buttons (use a Popover for those).

props.name: children
props.description: The one control it explains: an icon-only Button, a truncated label, a status mark.

props.name: kind
props.description: `label` (default): the control already carries these words, as its name (an icon-only Button's label) or its description (an unavailable Button's reason), so the hint is hidden from assistive technology and isn't read twice. `description`: extra words read after the name ("Last saved 2 minutes ago"), linked with `aria-describedby`.

props.name: side
props.description: The side it prefers; it flips when there's no room there. `start` and `end` follow the writing direction.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: A keyboard shortcut shown after the words, muted: "Ctrl+C". Put the same on the control's `aria-keyshortcuts`.

props.name: handlers
props.description: Spread on the element the pointer and focus land on (the Tooltip's wrapper, or a Button itself).

props.name: tip
props.description: The `role="tooltip"` element: render it inside the anchor, so the pointer can move onto it without leaving.

props.name: tipId
props.description: The tip's id, for `aria-describedby` when the hint is a description.
